description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to scanning and managing safe binary execution policies, including coverage analysis, trusted directory hints, and profile repair mechanisms within the 'exec-safe-bins' module.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredSafeBins
methods.description: Normalizes an array of entries into a sorted list of lowercase, trimmed safe bin names, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredTrustedSafeBinDirs
methods.description: Normalizes an array of entries into a list of trusted safe bin directories, filtering and sanitizing string entries.

methods.name: collectExecSafeBinScopes
methods.description: Collects execution scope references from the configuration, including global and agent-specific scopes with their safe bins, profiles, and trusted directories.

methods.name: scanExecSafeBinCoverage
methods.description: Scans the configuration for safe bin coverage issues, identifying missing profiles and risky semantics.

methods.name: scanExecSafeBinTrustedDirHints
methods.description: Identifies safe bins whose resolved paths are outside trusted directories, providing hints for potential misconfigurations.

methods.name: collectExecSafeBinCoverageWarnings
methods.description: Generates human-readable warnings based on coverage hits, including missing profiles and risky semantics, with instructions for fixing.

methods.name: collectExecSafeBinTrustedDirHintWarnings
methods.description: Creates warnings for safe bins that resolve outside trusted directories, suggesting configuration adjustments.

methods.name: maybeRepairExecSafeBinProfiles
methods.description: Attempts to repair missing safe bin profiles by adding scaffold profiles and providing warnings about unsafe configurations.
